$comment: lmrun template. Copy this file to lmrun.json in the same folder, then edit engines and profiles. lmrun.json is git-ignored on purpose so local paths stay out of the repo.

local.notes: kv logs drive the throughput dashboard; if your engine logs free-form text set log.style to plain, or map its key names with log.fields

fake.notes: no model and no port: streams fixed log lines so the dashboard can be checked safely

fake-plain.notes: same stand-in, treated as an engine whose logs are not key=value

$engine_template.$comment: Copy into engines for any llama.cpp-compatible server. Leave version null to read it from version_args. A bare command name ("python", "llama-server") is resolved through PATH; %LMRUN_HOME% expands to this folder. Logs that are not key=value: set log.style to plain (throughput stats need kv logs), or map the engine's names onto the ones lmrun reads, e.g. "fields": {"generated_tokens": "predicted_per_second_tokens", "prefill_tokens": "prompt_evaluated"}.

default.notes: one profile per model/quant you want to compare; anything extra here is ignored

fake.notes: eyeball the dashboard without loading a model: lmrun --profile fake

fake-plain.notes: log.style=plain: every line passes through and no throughput numbers are parsed
